standard_prerequisites.use: E_p locally constructible implies constructible in V_p.

standard_prerequisites.name: Intersections and collation of constructibles
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Topology, lemmas intersect-constructible-with-closed and collate-constructible-from-constructible (cross-chapter, named)

core_obligations: Forward: reduce to X quasi-compact, E constructible, U affine; U -> X quasi-compact; f^{-1}(E) constructible by the inverse-image lemma.
Converse: reduce to X quasi-compact quasi-separated; choose the finite stratification with scheme pieces V_p.
E_p is locally constructible in V_p, hence constructible (qcqs); intersect with the closed strata pieces.
Collate: E is the finite union of the constructible pieces |T_p| intersect E.
proof_roadmap: Forward reduction and inverse image; converse stratification; qcqs constructibility; collation.
difficulty_reason: A two-direction comparison with a stratified converse; the collation step is the finish.
